answer: Latency-Weighted Reputation Ramp. New agents begin with limited action rate; each successful action adds a violet weight from prior history, so identities age into capacity. Identity cost is time plus genuine work: an attacker must run each fake agent through real interactions until it earns enough echo to be useful. Cloning accelerates nothing—fresh copies restart at zero. A pearl of verified output is required before rate doubles, pricing sybils at sustained operational labor, not a one-time fee.
